title: Introduction to Chemistry - Chemistry - Dimensional Analysis
subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Which conversion factor is suitable for converting **grams** to **kilograms**?
questions.explain: To convert grams to kilograms, grams must be in the denominator to cancel out. The relationship is $1 \text{ kg} = 1000 \text{ g}$. Factor: $\frac{1 \text{ kg}}{1000 \text{ g}}$.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: The density of a substance is **2.0 g/mL**. What is the mass of **5.0 mL** of this substance?
questions.explain:
Density formula: $D = \frac{m}{V} \Rightarrow m = D \times V$.  
$m = 2.0 \text{ g/mL} \times 5.0 \text{ mL} = 10. \text{ g}$.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: Convert a speed of **72 km/h** to **m/s**.
questions.explain: $$ 72 \frac{\text{km}}{\text{h}} \times \frac{1000 \text{ m}}{1 \text{ km}} \times \frac{1 \text{ h}}{3600 \text{ s}} = \frac{72000}{3600} \text{ m/s} = 20 \text{ m/s} $$
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: How many **seconds** are in exactly **1.5 days**?
questions.explain: $$ 1.5 \text{ days} \times \frac{24 \text{ h}}{1 \text{ day}} \times \frac{3600 \text{ s}}{1 \text{ h}} = 1.5 \times 86,400 = 129,600 \text{ s} $$
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: A cube has a volume of **1.0 cubic meter ($m^3$)**. What is this volume in **cubic centimeters ($cm^3$)**?
questions.explain:
Since $1 \text{ m} = 100 \text{ cm}$, we must cube the conversion factor:  
$$ (1 \text{ m})^3 = (100 \text{ cm})^3 = 100 \times 100 \times 100 \text{ cm}^3 = 1,000,000 \text{ cm}^3 $$
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.q: If a car gets **30. miles per gallon**, what is this value in **miles per quart**? (1 gallon = 4 quarts)
questions.explain: $$ \frac{30 \text{ miles}}{1 \text{ gallon}} \times \frac{1 \text{ gallon}}{4 \text{ quarts}} = \frac{30}{4} \text{ miles/quart} = 7.5 \text{ miles/quart} $$
